title: Traders Sell Trims
description: Makes wandering Traders sometimes sell a Crate that drops Armor Trims.
body: This mod allows Wandering Traders to sometimes sell armor trims. It also supports modded armor trims so Wandering Traders can sell trims from other mods. May add the Ability for wandering traders to sell Sherds, Banner Patterns, and Music Discs in the Future.
